title: CoAP, Thread: Decouple Thread from CoAP and auto-decode UDP port 61631
description:
Previously, CoAP-TMF decoding was hardcoded inside packet-coap.c via
dedicated dissector handle coap_for_tmf, protocol proto_coap_for_tmf,
and subdissector table coap_tmf_media_type, requiring manual "Decode As"
configuration to parse Thread Management Framework traffic.

Remove all Thread-specific code and tables from packet-coap.c and
packet-coap.h, replacing them with a generic heuristic subdissector list
("coap") for unhandled CoAP payloads, modeled after packet-http.c.

In packet-thread.c, register a heuristic payload subdissector for "coap"
that inspects the URI namespace (/c/, /a/, /n/, /b/, /d/), and bind UDP
port 61631 to automatically decode Thread packets as CoAP.

notes.body:
> UDP port 61631 to automatically decode Thread packets as CoAP.

Nope, that's an unassigned Dynamic port, use Decode As.
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6282#section-4.3.1 notes that this is an issue with those ports for 6LoWPAN and Thread.
Is it acceptable to automatically decode it as CoAP as there are extra checks to make sure this is a Thread packet?
